d: In this week's edition of Sports This Week, Rupha Ramani brings you the biggest stories making headlines across the sporting world. From MS Dhoni announcing his IPL retirement and Cameron Bancroft reopening Australia's infamous Sandpaper scandal to the controversy surrounding India's U19 Asia Cup celebrations, Magnus Carlsen's chess forfeits and a racism row involving India's U17 football team, we look at the stories that forced us to dive deep beyond the field of play. Rupha Ramani breaks down the week's biggest sporting developments, controversies and talking points.
